FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'thank you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. Madame
   C. au revoir
   D. merci

2. How do you say 'well' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Madame
   B. bonjour
   C. oui
   D. bien

3. How do you say 'the mother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. la mère
   C. la grand-mère
   D. la famille

4. How do you say 'the sister' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le père
   B. la sœur
   C. le frère
   D. la famille

5. How do you say 'the table' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la cuisine
   B. la télé
   C. la table
   D. la salle de bain

6. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'TV'? (1 mark)
   A. téé
   B. télé
   C. tèlé
   D. tele

7. How do you say 'the door' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la douche
   B. la table
   C. le sac
   D. la porte

8. How do you say 'I rest' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je me repose
   B. je danse
   C. hier
   D. demain

9. How do you say 'the church' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'église
   B. la semaine
   C. le jour
   D. l'école

10. How do you say the month 'December' in French? (1 mark)
   A. octobre
   B. avril
   C. décembre
   D. mars

11. How do you say 'a month' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une fête
   B. une chanson
   C. un mois
   D. un gâteau

12. How do you say 'juice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les fruits
   B. le thé
   C. le jus
   D. les frites

13. How do you say 'health' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le poisson
   B. le jus
   C. le poulet
   D. la santé

14. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'shoulder'? (1 mark)
   A. épaule
   B. épale
   C. èpaule
   D. epaule

15. How do you say 'the head' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la dent
   B. l'oreille
   C. la tête
   D. la jambe

16. How do you say 'the hair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'épaule
   B. les cheveux
   C. l'oreille
   D. le nez

17. How do you say 'a lot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le soleil
   B. agréable
   C. l'orage
   D. beaucoup

18. How do you say 'the wind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la pluie
   B. le vent
   C. la neige
   D. le soleil

19. How do you say 'Excuse me' in French? (1 mark)
   A. De rien
   B. Allez
   C. Tournez
   D. Excusez-moi

20. Fill in: Le chat est ______ la table. (under) (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. dans
   C. sur
   D. devant

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write a short text of three sentences in French about your week. (4 marks) (4 marks)

22. Write the French words for: a birthday, a month, a present (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into French: 'My father is called David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Translate into French: 'It is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

25. Write the French words for: in, the door, the chair (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into French: 'I have two hands.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Translate into French: 'The door is next to the window.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

28. Translate into French: 'On Monday, I go to school.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'A week, seven days.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into French: 'My birthday is on 12 May.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — merci
   thank you in French is merci.

2. D — bien
   well in French is bien.

3. B — la mère
   the mother in French is la mère.

4. B — la sœur
   the sister in French is la sœur.

5. C — la table
   the table in French is la table.

6. B — télé
   The correct spelling is télé, with its accents.

7. D — la porte
   the door in French is la porte.

8. A — je me repose
   I rest in French is je me repose.

9. A — l'église
   the church in French is l'église.

10. C — décembre
   December in French is décembre.

11. C — un mois
   a month in French is un mois.

12. C — le jus
   juice in French is le jus.

13. D — la santé
   health in French is la santé.

14. A — épaule
   The correct spelling is épaule, with its accents.

15. C — la tête
   the head in French is la tête.

16. B — les cheveux
   the hair in French is les cheveux.

17. D — beaucoup
   a lot in French is beaucoup.

18. B — le vent
   the wind in French is le vent.

19. D — Excusez-moi
   Excuse me in French is Excusez-moi.

20. A — sous
   Sous means under.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Le lundi, je vais à l'école. Le samedi, je joue. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct small letters on the days.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: un anniversaire, un mois, un cadeau
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mon père s'appelle David.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il fait froid.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: dans, la porte, la chaise
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux mains.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Une semaine, sept jours.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.
